j4q.models

Class Background360

  • java.lang.Object
    • j4q.models.GameObject
      • j4q.models.Background360

  • public class Background360
extends GameObject
    Represents a 360-degree background sphere for VR rendering.

    The Background360 class creates a spherical mesh for panoramic backgrounds, supporting fisheye projection and texture assignment.
